en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a mid‑20th‑century modernist multi‑storey corner building at a street intersection, viewed from across a landscaped garden with flowerbeds and steps in the foreground. There are pedestrians, a cyclist, and a vintage car on the street, plus lampposts and a traffic light. In the upper left corner the printed caption reads "Vedere din Cluj".
